summary: First-pass end-to-end T1 testing of the DelDOT DMV Casework hackathon dashboard. Backend endpoints (/api/stats, /api/cases with filters/sort, /api/cases/{id}, PATCH, /api/audit, POST /api/cases/import multipart, GET /api/cases/export/csv, POST /api/cases/reset) all respond 200 with expected shape. Frontend UI (Overview stat cards+histogram+classification mix, Queue with 60 rows and search filter reflecting in URL q param, Case Detail with priority-gauge/probability-bars/T0-T1 diff and 7 diff rows, decision + save notes, Audit log with entries, Import/Export controls + Download CSV) all functional. Non-determinative disclaimer visible on every visited page.
passed: GET /api/stats returns total=60, by_class {review_warranted:13, review_not_warranted:13, insufficient_evidence:34}, priority_bins length 10, shift_delta_count present, top_states, reviewer_status
GET /api/cases returns 60 cases with expected fields and filters (predicted_class=review_warranted&priority_band=high&sort=review_priority&order=desc returns 2 sorted correctly)
GET /api/cases/DE-100001 returns full nested t0/t1 with all 7 fields; unknown ID returns 404
PATCH /api/cases/DE-100001 updates reviewer_status/notes and returns updated case
GET /api/audit returns entries with candidate_id, action, reviewer_id, from_status, to_status, timestamp
POST /api/cases/reset seeds 60 mock cases; POST /api/cases/import (replace=true) round-trips 60 rows with 0 errors
GET /api/cases/export/csv returns text/csv with expected header columns
Frontend Overview renders stat cards (Total 60, High 2, Warranted 13, Shifts 13), histogram, classification breakdown
Frontend Queue lists 60 rows with priority bar, class badge, probability mini-bar, T0->T1 chip, reviewer status; search q reflects in URL and narrows results (q=DE-100001 -> 1 row)
Case Detail shows priority-gauge, probability-bars, t0-t1-diff with 7 diff-row entries; decision-confirmed_warranted updates status, save-notes shows success toast
Audit page lists audit-row entries after decisions
Import/Export page shows csv-file-input dropzone, reset-mock button, and Download CSV export link
Non-determinative disclaimer banner present on Overview, Queue, Case Detail, Audit, and Import/Export pages

failed.issue: GET /api/cases returns object {cases:[], total:n} instead of a plain array as stated in the review request. Frontend consumes data.cases, so UI works, but the spec wording says 'returns array of cases'.

action_items: Optional: clarify /api/cases response shape in spec (currently {cases,total}) or flatten to a plain array if strict spec compliance is desired.
